concerns.text: Success criterion SC-002 (Pearson correlation r ≥ 0.8 with p < 0.05) is not referenced by any task; there is no checklist item that verifies the monotonic scaling of FTLE bias with noise amplitude.
The contract `regression_stats.schema.yaml` is defined in the data‑model but no task creates a JSON artifact that conforms to this schema (e.g., a `regression_stats.json` file).

Success criterion SC-001 requires an independent RK45 integration (rtol = 1e-10, atol = 1e-13) to validate the clean‑system baseline; the baseline task T009 does not include this independent verification step.
